content: {"summary":"In February 2025 a simultaneous name‑resolution outage affected auth, catalog and orders services.","likely_cause":"CPU starvation of the two CoreDNS pods (both at their CPU limits) prevented them from forwarding prod.internal queries, causing the cascade.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"CoreDNS pods were at CPU ceiling, starving them and causing loss of name resolution across namespaces.","evidence_ids":["INC-0016#1","INC-0016#2"],"quote":"2 replicas, each flat against its CPU ceiling"},{"text":"Scaling CoreDNS to four replicas restored lookups.","evidence_ids":["INC-0016#1"],"quote":"scaled coredns to 4 replicas"}],"next_checks":["Examine CoreDNS CPU usage trends before the incident","Review resource limits and autoscaling policies for CoreDNS","Check for any spikes in DNS query volume that could saturate CPU","Validate health of internal‑dns upstream servers"]}
